# data/external

Population data has **not** been collected yet, so `population_raw.csv` does not exist.

If it is added, keep it separate from the cybercrime files and document: source_id, publisher, report title, year(s), State/UT coverage and boundaries, method (census, projection, NCRB mid-year estimate), and how its State/UT names map to `docs/state_ut_naming_reference.csv`. Recommended first choice: the population column NCRB uses for crime rates in the same *Crime in India* table, so numerator and denominator match. See `docs/data_collection_summary.md` section 6.
